test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

The action of using someone or something as a model
solution: The correct answer is **imitation.** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** __ • ** ****Imitation**: the act of copying somebody/something (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु की नक़ल करना) • For example: Good pronunciation of a language is best learnt by imitation. • As we can see, the meaning of 'imitation' perfectly describes the given group of words. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Imitation.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • The meanings of the rest of the options are given below: • **Magic: **the art of doing tricks that seem impossible in order to entertain people. (लोगों के मनोरंजन के लिए असंभव लगने वाले करतब दिखाने की कला, हाथ की सफ़ाई का खेल) • **Foundation:** the idea, principle, or fact on which something is based. (आधारभूत विचार, सिद्घांत या तथ्‍य) • **Caption:** the words that are written above or below a picture, photograph, etc. to explain what it is about. (चित्र, फ़ोटो आदि के ऊपर या नीचे दी लिखित सूचना; शीर्षक, अनुशीर्षक) 39:Tfa1, The correct answer is- **"Vehical".**
